name: CanvasTTY Assistant
description: The Assistant: reviews agents' shell commands and file writes before they run, and helps orchestrators: a route tool that picks where a subagent runs (your subscriptions, coding plans, model accounts or Auto), flows (roles and tasks an orchestrator asks you to approve), a task board, loop alerts on cards a session report, and Model: Auto (Jev) for OpenCode (a local, key-protected router on 127.0.0.1 that picks an allowed model per turn). Decision models (Jev, Laya, Eikos, Ollama) are optional. Settings → Plugins → CanvasTTY Assistant → Settings.
description.ru: Помощник: проверяет команды и записи файлов агентов до запуска и помогает оркестраторам: инструмент route выбирает, где запустить субагента (ваши подписки, планы для кода, аккаунты моделей или «Авто»), сценарии (роли и задачи, которые оркестратор просит одобрить), доска задач, сигнал «цикл?» на окне отчёт о сессии и модель «Авто (Jev)» для OpenCode (локальный маршрутизатор на 127.0.0.1 с ключом, выбирает разрешённую модель на каждый ход). Модели решений (Jev, Laya, Eikos, Ollama) не обязательны. Настройки → Плагины → Ассистент CanvasTTY → Настройки.
author: CanvasTTY contributors

services.title: Assistant
services.description: Command review, launch triage, routing, flows, task boards, loop alerts, session reports and the Auto (Jev) model router (127.0.0.1 only, while Auto is used).

tools.name: recommend
tools.description: Ask the Assistant how to run a task before you spawn a subagent for it: its kind and difficulty, whether it needs a worktree or a container, whether command review will be strict, whether it splits into parallel subagents, and whether the task misses information. Advice only: nothing is started.

task.description: The task text you would give the subagent.

tools.name: review_status
tools.description: How the Assistant's command review runs now (mode, strictness, decision models) and its last decisions on your card and your subagents: what was allowed, declined or sent to the person, and why.

tools.name: route
tools.description: Before spawn_agent: where a subagent should run, as CLI, sign-in (the person's subscription on that CLI, a coding plan, a model account, or Model: Auto (Jev)), model and effort, chosen from measured benchmark scores for the task type, price or subscription window share, availability and the person's rules. Pass list_providers().providers as `providers`, and canvastty-accounts__list_routes rows as `accountRoutes` when you have them (once: later calls may omit them, or pass a compact `digest`). Pass the answer's spawn values to spawn_agent unchanged: they name every plugin that sets a model, so nothing is inherited by accident. Up to two alternatives come with it. Nothing is started here. When the subagent ends, report it with route_outcome.

task.description: The task text you would give the subagent.

providers.description: list_providers().providers, once per orchestrator: later calls may omit it (kept 30 min) or send `digest`.

accountRoutes.description: Optional, older setups: canvastty-accounts__list_routes rows. Where the person allowed the Assistant to read Accounts, it reads accounts, pools and quotas itself and ignores these.

prefer.description: Optional: a CLI id, a model, or a plan or account id the person asked for; it wins when it is usable.

orchestrate.description: Optional: the subagent must itself orchestrate (needs CanvasTTY's agent tools).

digest.description: Optional compact form instead of the lists: CLIs with sign-in and ready account ids, e.g. "claude:ok codex:signed_out opencode @glm-53".

cwd.description: Optional: the folder you will give spawn_agent, so the answer is matched to that subagent.

compact.description: Optional: a short answer (default for pick_route).

tools.name: pick_route
tools.description: Where a subagent should run (CLI, sign-in, model, effort, launch options), the same as route but with a short answer: the choice and up to two alternatives as spawn values for spawn_agent, a decisionId for route_outcome. Pass list_providers().providers (and canvastty-accounts__list_routes rows) on the first call only; afterwards just `task`, or a `digest` like "claude:ok opencode @glm-53" (CLIs with sign-in, @ ready accounts). Pass spawn unchanged.

task.description: The task text you would give the subagent.

providers.description: list_providers().providers, once per orchestrator: later calls may omit it (kept 30 min) or send `digest`.

accountRoutes.description: Optional, older setups: canvastty-accounts__list_routes rows. Where the person allowed the Assistant to read Accounts, it reads accounts, pools and quotas itself and ignores these.

prefer.description: Optional: a CLI id, a model, or a plan or account id the person asked for; it wins when it is usable.

orchestrate.description: Optional: the subagent must itself orchestrate (needs CanvasTTY's agent tools).

digest.description: Optional compact form instead of the lists: CLIs with sign-in and ready account ids, e.g. "claude:ok codex:signed_out opencode @glm-53".

cwd.description: Optional: the folder you will give spawn_agent, so the answer is matched to that subagent.

compact.description: Optional: a short answer (default for pick_route).

tools.name: route_outcome
tools.description: After a subagent started from a route answer has ended: what came of it, so routes that fail or hit usage limits are used less. Pass the decisionId from route, or the subagent's sessionId, and the status and exitLines wait_for_agent or get_agent_result gave you.

decisionId.description: The decisionId from the route answer.

status.description: How it ended (wait_for_agent's reason or get_agent_result's state).

exitLines.description: Optional: its exitLines; only read to see whether it hit a usage limit, not kept.

ok.description: Optional: false when it ended but did not do the task.

tokens.description: Optional: tokens the subagent used, when you know them (for the cost of a plan's models).

tools.name: autopilot_plan
tools.description: Auto (Jev): how to split your task before you start subagents. Give the whole task; the answer says solo (do it yourself), orchestrate N (at most N subagents) or deep (parts may split once more), the strategy and the budget. On an Auto card the child count is enforced; call again to re-plan.

tools.name: start_leaf
tools.description: Run one independent leaf task on a server the person declared in the Assistant settings (off unless they turned it on), as a card on that server's own CLI sign-in. It cannot start subagents. Check it with leaf_status.

tools.name: leaf_status
tools.description: The status of a leaf card you started with start_leaf.

tools.name: flows_list
tools.description: Lists flows: named sets of roles (for example executor and reviewer), built in and from this project's .canvastty/flows folder. Use flow_plan to propose one.

tools.name: flow_plan
tools.description: Asks the person to approve a flow for a goal. Returns only the plan id and the role names: the person sees roles, provider/model and tasks in the Flow preview card and presses Start or Cancel. Do not start subagents for it before flow_status says approved; it then gives the spawn values.

providers.description: Optional: the providers array from list_providers, so the suggestion uses what is installed, signed in and its known models.

tools.name: flow_status
tools.description: Whether the person started or cancelled your flow plan (waits up to 10 s). When approved, it lists exactly what to pass to spawn_agent for each role.

planId.description: The plan id from flow_plan; omit for your newest plan (also one the person chose for you).

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait for the person, 0 to 10 seconds (default 10).

tools.name: task_add
tools.description: Adds a task to your task board (the person sees it in the Task board card). Optionally give it to one of your subagents by session id.

assignee.description: Optional session id of one of your subagents.

tools.name: task_update
tools.description: Updates a task on the board: status todo, doing, done or blocked, and a short note. A subagent may update a task given to it, or claim an unassigned one.

id.description: The task id, for example t3.

note.description: A short note (what changed, what blocks it).

assignee.description: Orchestrator only: a subagent session id, or empty to clear.

tools.name: task_list
tools.description: The task board of your orchestrator (or your own, for an orchestrator): ids, titles, status, assignee and notes.

contributions.title: Assistant
contributions.description: Command review, automatic routing, loop alerts and flows.

contributions.title: Decision models
contributions.description: Optional decision models (Jev, Laya, Eikos, Ollama), data rules, recent reviews, Auto (Jev) model routing and where agents run.

contributions.title: Flow preview
contributions.description: Roles and tasks of a proposed flow, for you to approve or cancel.

contributions.title: Task board
contributions.description: Tasks of an orchestrator and its subagents.

contributions.title: Agent tree
contributions.description: Who started whom: an orchestrator and its agents with model, status, task, cost and time. Click a card to show it on the canvas.
